cards.example_en: We visit the science museum with our class each spring.
cards.example_zh: 每年春天我们都和全班一起参观科学博物馆。

cards.scene: 出行交通 · Travel and Transport
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：有趣的
cards.example_en: Grandpa told an amusing joke while we washed the dishes.
cards.example_zh: 我们洗碗时，爷爷讲了一个有趣的笑话。

cards.scene: 出行交通 · Travel and Transport
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：背包旅行
cards.example_en: Backpacking through the hills left us hungry and happy.
cards.example_zh: 在山里背包旅行了一趟，我们又饿又开心。

cards.scene: 出行交通 · Travel and Transport
cards.example_en: There is free parking at the supermarket.

cards.scene: 出行交通 · Travel and Transport
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：了不起的
cards.example_en: Her remarkable memory lets her recall every classmate's birthday.
cards.example_zh: 她的记忆力了不起，能记住每位同学的生日。

cards.scene: 出行交通 · Travel and Transport
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：传统的
cards.example_en: A conventional oven takes longer than our microwave at home.
cards.example_zh: 家里的传统烤箱比微波炉花的时间更长。

cards.scene: 出行交通 · Travel and Transport
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：非法的
cards.example_en: Parking on the pavement is illegal in our city.
cards.example_zh: 在我们这座城市，把车停在人行道上是非法的。

cards.scene: 出行交通 · Travel and Transport
cards.example_en: The editor moved my photo to the front page of the school paper.
cards.example_zh: 编辑把我的照片放到了校报头版。

cards.scene: 出行交通 · Travel and Transport
cards.example_en: We put a poster on the classroom wall.
cards.example_zh: 我们把一张海报贴在教室墙上。

cards.scene: 出行交通 · Travel and Transport
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：感激的
cards.example_en: We were grateful when a stranger returned my brother's phone.
cards.example_zh: 一位陌生人送回了我弟弟的手机，我们非常感激。

cards.scene: 出行交通 · Travel and Transport
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：旅游者
cards.example_en: The tourist photographed the bridge from the bus.
cards.example_zh: 那位旅游者从公共汽车上拍下了那座桥。

cards.scene: 出行交通 · Travel and Transport
cards.example_en: The train will arrive at six o'clock.

cards.scene: 出行交通 · Travel and Transport
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：集会；早会
cards.example_en: Morning assembly starts at eight in the main hall.
cards.example_zh: 晨会八点在大礼堂开始。

cards.scene: 出行交通 · Travel and Transport
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：勇敢地
cards.example_en: She bravely told the teacher the truth.
cards.example_zh: 她勇敢地把实情告诉了老师。

cards.scene: 出行交通 · Travel and Transport
cards.example_en: Grandad sleeps in his chair with the telly still on.
cards.example_zh: 爷爷在椅子上睡着了，电视却还开着。
